title: Baseball Pass Long Outlet
description: Players practise the one-hand baseball pass over 15 to 20 metres to a teammate leaking out, the long pass that starts a fast break.

content.objective: Throw an accurate, catchable one-hand pass over a long distance, leading a running teammate.
content.setup: Passers under the basket with balls; receivers start at the free-throw line extended on the sideline.
content.organization: Passer becomes receiver; receiver lays up and goes to the passer line.
instructions: The receiver sprints up the sideline toward the far end.
The passer steps toward the target and throws a baseball pass: ball behind the ear, one-hand throw, follow-through to the target.
Lead the receiver so they catch beyond half court.
The receiver finishes at the far rim.
coachingPoints: Step with the opposite foot, like a catcher's throw.
Backspin keeps the pass straight; avoid side spin.
Aim at the receiver's lead shoulder.
commonMistakes: Throwing with two hands and losing distance.
Side spin that curves the pass out of bounds.
Throwing at the receiver instead of ahead.
content.safety: Receivers look back for the ball; no one else on the sideline lane during the throw.
progressions: Add a defender chasing the receiver.
Pass after a rebound from a missed shot.
regressions: Shorter distance to the free-throw line extended.
variations: Bounce the baseball pass once at the end (for shorter distances).
Hit a receiver cutting to the middle.
successCriteria: Pass is caught in stride beyond half court.
No pass goes out of bounds in the set.
content.gameApplication: One long pass beats the whole defense down the floor for a lay-up.
